about.title: About the Fabled set
paragraphs: Fabled is the 9th Disney Lorcana booster set, released on 5 September 2025. It has 243 cards: 205 in the main set, 18 Epic, 18 Enchanted and 2 Iconic cards. There are also 205 foils, one for each main set card.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 205 main set cards), the Master set (410 cards, adding the foils) or the Grand Master set (all 448 cards, adding the Epic, Enchanted and Iconic cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
